decision.interpretation: Document type line 'NGHỊ ĐỊNH' in bold, centered above the full title, operates at its location as the primary heading.
First line of the decree's full title in bold, directly follows the document type line, introduces the regulatory scope.
Second line of the decree's full title in bold, completes the title text, operates at its location.
'Chương I' (Chapter I) in bold, marks the start of the first substantive chapter of the document.
'QUY ĐỊNH CHUNG' (General Provisions) in bold, serves as the section heading within Chapter I.
'Điều 1. Phạm vi điều chỉnh' (Article 1. Scope of Regulation) in bold, introduces the first article's content.
